mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.openday, r.rest FROM reserverest AS r WHERE r.onedayclass_num = #{onedayclass_num} AND DATE_FORMAT(r.openday, '%Y-%m') = #{searchMonth} AND manageStatus='open'
mapper.update: UPDATE reserverest SET rest = rest - 1 WHERE id = #{reserverest_id} AND rest > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reserveinfo (merchant_uid, reserverest_id, reserve_payment_id, user_code, selectedDate,onedayclass_num) VALUES (#{merchant_uid}, #{reserverest_id}, #{reserve_payment_id}, #{user_code}, #{selectedDate},#{onedayclass_num})
mapper.select: SELECT r.selectedDate FROM reserveinfo AS r WHERE user_code = #{user_code} AND DATE_FORMAT(selectedDate, '%Y-%m') =#{searchMonth}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO onedayclass_applicantinfo ( user_code, name, phone, email, reserveinfo_num ) VALUES ( #{user_code}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{reserveinfo_num}
)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM reserve_payment AS rp WHERE DATE(rp.created_at) = CURRENT_DATE OR rp.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 6 MONTH ) AS recently_reserve_payment INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM reserveinfo AS r WHERE r.user_code = #{user_code} ) AS recently_reserveinfo ON recently_reserve_payment.merchant_uid = recently_reserveinfo.merchant_uid INNER JOIN onedayclass_applicantinfo AS oa ON recently_reserveinfo.reserveinfo_num = oa.reserveinfo_num INNER JOIN onedayclass AS oc ON oc.onedayclass_num = recently_reserveinfo.onedayclass_num ORDER BY recently_reserve_payment.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT reservestatus, reserveinfo_num,reserveinfo.onedayclass_num,openday,reserve_img , openday, merchant_uid,user.user_name ,user.user_tell ,onedayclass.onedayclass_price ,onedayclass.onedayclass_name,application_day from reserveinfo INNER JOIN user on reserveinfo.user_code=user.user_code INNER JOIN onedayclass ON reserveinfo.onedayclass_num=onedayclass.onedayclass_num WHERE user.user_code=#{user_code}
